title: 给我整个平台跳跃
description:
Week 10: Knytt Stories

Actually there are not many discovery this week. So I will write about Knytt Stories. It is a 2D plafformer game. And you can design your own levels.

I finished UI Design, Scriptable Object， DOTS introduction and Version Control in the Unity best practices.

Marvel version Daredevil is on. I watched the first episode. I think I will follow this series.
